name: foo
description: Type catalog: one attribute per supported type. Each attribute's description documents the type. Copy/trim into duplocloud/specs/<name>.json for a real resource. (Reference only — not embedded.)

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: Path parameter (matches {workspace_id} in the endpoint UriBase). No apiPath — goes into the URL, not the body.

attributes.name: a_string
attributes.description: string. Supports default, oneOf, sensitive, forceNew.

attributes.name: a_bool
attributes.description: bool.

attributes.name: an_int
attributes.description: int (int64).

attributes.name: a_number
attributes.description: number (float64).

attributes.name: an_enum
attributes.description: string with an enum constraint via oneOf.

attributes.name: a_secret
attributes.description: sensitive string (hidden in plan/CLI output).

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: list(string). Element type may be string|bool|int|number.

attributes.name: ports
attributes.description: list(int).

attributes.name: zones
attributes.description: set(string). Unordered, de-duplicated.

attributes.name: weights
attributes.description: set(number).

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: map(string). Keys are strings; element type may be string|bool|int|number.

attributes.name: flags
attributes.description: map(bool).

attributes.name: settings
attributes.description: Single nested object. Nested fields are full attributes with their own paths.

attributes.name: timeout_ms
attributes.description: Nested field renamed to camelCase via a relative apiPath.

attributes.name: verbose
attributes.description: Nested field with no apiPath defaults to its own name.

attributes.name: limits
attributes.description: Objects can contain collections.

attributes.name: ingress
attributes.description: list(object). Each element is the nested object below.

attributes.name: rules
attributes.description: set(object).

attributes.name: backends
attributes.description: map(object): string keys, object values. Objects nest recursively.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Computed-only: read from the response, never sent.

attributes.name: node_ids
attributes.description: Computed list built by mapping over a response array (the [] operator).
